profile.headline: Frontend Developer - TypeScript, Javascript (ES6), MongoDB, Express, Next.js, React, NodeJS, HTML & CSS
profile.summary:
I am a Front-end Developer with an interest in learning Back-end Development. I have experience helping to create MVPs and designing mobile Applications. Along with a few full-stack web applications in my free time. I am adept at working with APIs and the Next.js and React Frameworks.  I am looking for an environment where my skills as a developer can grow and where we can rethink the future together.

I have been trained to mediate arguments and bring them to a peaceful solution. I am a big fan and quite skilled at finding the win- win solution to arguments and pride myself in always keeping a cool head.  I am looking for an environment that supports the use of new approaches to tired problems. As Einstein said, ”The significant problems we have cannot be solved at the same level of thinking with which we created them”.

I enjoy learning about and integrating new systems, practices, and technologies.  I have a history with working in and leading teams as well as talking with and assisting people one on one. I also have an extensive working knowledge of computers and most operating systems. Additionally, I understand and can speak Conversational Spanish. I am a really quick study and adapt easily to any situation.
In my search for employment I seek the excitement of new possibilities and the opportunity of novel problems. I enjoy thinking out of the box to find solutions that address obstacles from a systemic approach. After all, as Henry Ford once said, “Obstacles are those frightful things you see when you take your eyes off your goal.”

I enjoy engaging my right brain through creative practices. As Gloria Steinem once stated,”without great leaps of imagination or dreaming, we lose the excitement of possibilities”. In the end, I feel it is our creative side that compels us to keep exploring our horizons and grow. I am looking for a place that fosters this type of mindset.
